resources.string: Standby panels connect to this panel on the panel port and share its CA and master key. They are read-only; all edits happen on the primary panel.

This is a standby panel that syncs the primary panel in real time. After it is promoted, other standby panels sync from it instead; the old primary becomes a standby when it recovers, and changes it made in its last seconds may be lost.
Promote this panel to primary? Nodes will only accept changes from this panel. Do not promote while the primary is still running, or the two panels will diverge.
Promoted to primary. The panel is restarting.
Remove standby panel %1$s? It can no longer sync this panel, and its data directory must be deleted manually.
Run this command on the standby machine.
The data directory must be empty. The pairing code is valid for 1 hour and can be used once. The standby connects and starts syncing once it starts, and appears in the list.
Used when another panel hands over nodes. To add a new machine, add a node on the Nodes page.
Join codes are valid for 1 hour and can be used by several nodes. Nodes that join with a code must be approved on the Nodes page before use.
Paste this code when handing over nodes on the other panel, or run nagi panel add <code> on the node.
Revoke join code %1$s? It can no longer be used to add nodes.
